g.text: Setting: Kuaishou, short video and live streaming
One ranking model serves ads, shopping and live streaming. It predicts CTR, CVR, gifts, follows …
It should use the whole history, but scoring 100,000 items per candidate in streaming training is
not affordable. Every lifelong model therefore first cuts the history down.
Items are videos, live streams and products with titles, images, OCR and speech. An LLM can read them.
The question of both papers: how do we turn that understanding into something the ranker can use?
QARM V2 (arXiv:2602.08559), §1 ("tens of millions of fresh new items … every day")
